_comment: M0, the cold-open bed: a bar-line edit of one Eleven Music take (music_v1, seed 909, 20 s, 119.98 BPM, beats at 0.027 + k/2 s, G minor-ish: G/C/D). Raw take: sub pulse + ticking hats 0-8 (no stabs), a little more body 8-12, the synth stabs build 12-14.75, the peak stabs 14.75-16.75, then it fades to silence by 17 (no riser of its own). Bar 1 is that pulse band-split to the sub and the hats only; the riser is synthesized here and is cut dead with everything else by the hard stop (6 ms ramp) on the last bar line.

segments.why: bar 1: the pulse (stripped to sub + hats below)
bars 2-3.5: source bars 6-7.5, the build into the first half of the peak; hard stop at 7.0 on the loud stab

sweeps.why: bar 1 sparse: only the sub pulse and the ticking hats

synth.why: the riser, peaking at the hard stop
